versions.changelog:
Initial release of the alibabacloud-odps-information-schema skill.

- Enables querying MaxCompute (ODPS) Information Schema metadata views for governance, auditing, and cost/usage analysis.
- Supports tenant-level (recommended) and project-level (deprecated) Information Schema with clear adaptation rules.
- Requires namespace flag for tenant-level queries; handles both MCP and odpscmd execution channels.
- Answers natural language queries about tables, columns, jobs history, permissions, quota usage, and more—NOT for general DDL/DML or table listing.
- Includes critical usage rules, column name references, and guidance for handling history, time columns, and cross-project behavior.
